# Support

For reproducible software defects, documentation errors, or feature
suggestions, use the GitHub issue tracker. Include your operating system,
application version, concise steps to reproduce, and the expected and actual
behavior.

Use synthetic data only. Remove passwords, access tokens, `.env` values,
database files, real patient/client details, and private model-provider logs
before posting. Do not upload a full log unless you have checked it for
sensitive content.

TheraSim does not provide clinical support, diagnosis, treatment
recommendations, professional supervision, or emergency services. It is not a
validated assessment or production clinical product. For security concerns,
see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) instead of opening a public issue.
